  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially after sentiment > 0.00).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.00) or transitions to negative.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is neutral or negative and price is trending downward.",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent highs: if last 3-5 days show strong upward momentum, cap forecast growth to 5% max.",
    "If sentiment is positive and price is falling, reduce forecast by 3-5% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "For long-term horizon (e.g., 30-day), apply smoothing: if true outcome deviates > 10% from forecast, adjust next forecast by 20% of deviation toward historical mean."
  ]
}
